remarks: Completely renovated 3-bedroom apartment in the heart of Greenwich offering approximately 1,250 sq ft of living space with solid hardwood floors throughout. Features include fresh paint, updated lighting and ceiling fans, stainless steel appliances, dishwasher, in-unit washer and dryer, and ample storage. Conveniently located just minutes from Westchester County and only blocks from downtown Greenwich, shopping, dining, and transportation.  Min. 650 FICO score and 2.5 times rent.
